author: claude
title: Custom terrain stays in use offline (offline QA_ site, saved flight)

requirement.text:
Android
Offline - Download a flight plan offline with custom terrain imported and make sure the custom terrain is still used when going offline

Test with terrain from various latitudes and make sure we have the same resolution constraint everywhere. e.g. ( create new sites for all of them )
Alaska
Antarctica
South Africa
Spain

source.locator: New test description, W-20261104-015 (offline; your answer: write the case)

expected: A new QA_ site with Enable offline use downloads ('Site available offline'). In a new flight there, Add terrain / map > Import file accepts Zurich_47.35N_28m_UTM.tif (about 28 m) and imports it; it processes (MAP) and is chosen as the flight's terrain (the terrain selector shows QA_<run>); the flight saves ('Flight successfully saved'). With Wi-Fi off and the app offline, the terrain selector still shows QA_<run> and no error appears.

fixtures.name: Zurich_47.35N_28m_UTM.tif
fixtures.delivery: engine: act.py deliver copies it to device_path on each tablet when it is missing and checks its sha256 there; a different file at that path is never overwritten

test_data.new_site: QA_{target} Offline terrain {time} in the CT account (stays there)

cloud_writes.object: new site QA_{target} Offline terrain {time} in the CT account
cloud_writes.what: creates the site (stays) and its offline download to the tablet
creates the flight QA_<tablet> Offline terrain
imports the 28 m DSM as map QA_<run> and adds it to the flight
opens Missing basic components (the planner's Save)
saves the flight as a draft with QA_<run> as its terrain

forbidden: any site other than the one this case creates
the New flight form's site field

preconditions.text: the DSM on the tablet in Download/QA-TERR-013
tablet online at start (the case switches Wi-Fi off itself)

routing.symbol: FromFile flow: MapFromUploadsCreator with the flight's site and flight

steps_note: Written 2026-11-04 from New test W-20261104-015. Controls read from source at 82e23ff; not yet run on a device. It checks the open planner after Wi-Fi off; it does not leave and reopen the flight offline (no engine pattern for opening a saved flight yet). Known risk: on 1.73.0 Android the terrain selector offered only World (upAxis regression).

steps.text: Top bar: Sites (a planner left open by an earlier run asks to save first)
steps.helper: act.py {target} tap testid:btn-sites --expect "js:/Exit without saving/.test(document.body.innerText) || location.pathname === '/sites'" --timeout 20

steps.text: Exit without saving, when the app asks (writes nothing)
New site (opens site creation with the name field)
Site name: QA_{target} Offline terrain {time}
Location: type the lat/long 47.352000, 8.491000
Wait for the lat/long suggestion
Pick the lat/long suggestion: the map centres there and the default site area is set
Turn on Enable offline use
steps.helper: act.py {target} tap "text:Enable offline use" --expect "js:[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=checkbox]')].some(e => { let p = e; for (let i = 0; i < 4 && p; i++) { if (/Enable offline use/.test(p.innerText || '')) return e.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true' || e.getAttribute('data-state') === 'checked'; p = p.parentElement; } return false; })" --timeout 15

steps.text: Next (storage check; goes to the coordinate system step)
Wait until Save new site is enabled (coordinate system ready)
Save new site: creates the QA_ site (cloud write) and starts its offline download
Wait for 'Site available offline' (up to 5 min)
steps.helper: act.py {target} wait --expect "js:/Site available offline|Failed to make|Cannot make site available offline|Not enough storage/.test(document.body.innerText)" --timeout 300

steps.text: Check the site is available offline
steps.read_js: ({available: /Site available offline/.test(document.body.innerText), failed: /Failed to make|Cannot make site available offline|Not enough storage/.test(document.body.innerText)})

assert.expr: v['download']['available'] is True and v['download']['failed'] is False

steps.text: Wait for Create flight in the empty site
Create flight (opens the New flight form)
Flight name
Wait until Create is enabled
Create: creates the QA_ flight in this run's own site and opens its planner (cloud write)
Open the layers panel (Layers button, bottom left)
Layers: + (add layer menu)
Choose Add terrain / map
steps.helper: act.py {target} tap "text:Add terrain / map" --expect "text:Use existing map (WingtraCLOUD)"

steps.text: Choose Import file
Next (opens the Import file dialog; writes nothing)
Open the system file chooser (photo picker opens)
Photo picker: More
Photo picker: Browse… (opens the full-screen file browser)
File browser: open the places (Show roots)
File browser: the internal storage (titled with the tablet's device name)
File browser: Download
File browser: the case's own folder QA-TERR-013
File browser: tap Zurich_47.35N_28m_UTM.tif; the app comes back
Wait until the dialog shows Zurich_47.35N_28m_UTM.tif
Read the dialog: Zurich_47.35N_28m_UTM.tif (about 28 m) with no low-resolution warning and Next enabled
steps.read_js: (() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const nx = d && [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Next'); const t = d ? d.innerText : ''; return {text: t, low_res: /Dataset has too low resolution/.test(t), next_disabled: nx ? nx.disabled : null}; })()

assert.expr: 'Zurich_47.35N_28m_UTM.tif' in v['card']['text'] and v['card']['low_res'] is False and v['card']['next_disabled'] is False

steps.text: First Next (reads the coordinate system; writes nothing)
Dataset name QA_{run}
Close the keyboard
Wait for the name in the form
steps.helper: act.py {target} wait --expect "js:(() => { const i = document.querySelector('[data-testid=input-dataset-name]'); return !!(i && i.value === 'QA_{run}'); })()" --timeout 20

steps.text: Read the form: name QA_<run>, this run's own site, Next enabled
steps.read_js: (() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const i = document.querySelector('[data-testid=input-dataset-name]'); const nx = d && [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Next'); return {text: d ? d.innerText : '', name: i ? i.value : null, next_disabled: nx ? nx.disabled : null}; })()

assert.expr: v['form']['name'] == 'QA_' + run and 'Offline terrain' in v['form']['text'] and v['form']['next_disabled'] is False

steps.text: Second Next: imports the DSM into this flight's site and adds it to the flight (cloud write)
Wait for the server-side processing (10 min), then read the map's status
steps.read_js: (async () => { const t = localStorage.getItem('accessToken') || ''; const h = {Authorization: 'Bearer ' + t}; const base = 'https://api.staging.company.example/api/v1'; const s = await window.Capacitor.Plugins.CapacitorHttp.get({url: base + '/sites', headers: h}); const sd = s.data || []; const arr = Array.isArray(sd) ? sd : (sd.items || sd.data || sd.sites || []); const site = arr.find(x => x.name === 'QA_{target} Offline terrain {time}'); if (!site) return {site: false}; const l = await window.Capacitor.Plugins.CapacitorHttp.get({url: base + '/datasets/sites/' + site.id, headers: h}); const d = (l.data || []).find(x => x.name === 'QA_{run}'); if (!d) return {site: true, found: false}; const r = await window.Capacitor.Plugins.CapacitorHttp.get({url: base + '/datasets/' + d.id + '/map-outputs', headers: h}); return {site: true, found: true, status: (r.data || {}).datasetStatus}; })()

steps.text: Open the layers panel again (when closed)
Wait for the terrain selector
Open the terrain selector (only when it does not show QA_<run> yet)
Choose QA_<run> as the flight's terrain (a local choice; saved with the flight)
Wait until the terrain selector shows QA_<run>
Screenshot: the flight online with its custom terrain
Read the terrain selector online

assert.expr: v['online']['label'] is not None and ('QA_' + run) in v['online']['label']

steps.text: Save (planner): no area yet, so Missing basic components opens
steps.helper: act.py {target} tap text:Save --expect "js:/Missing basic components|Flight overview/i.test(document.body.innerText)" --timeout 30

steps.text: Save in Missing basic components: saves the flight (draft) with its terrain (cloud write)
steps.helper: act.py {target} tap text:Save --expect "js:(window.__qaToasts || []).some(x => /Flight successfully saved|went wrong|error/i.test(x))" --timeout 30

steps.text: Check the save message
Wi-Fi off on the tablet; wait until the app shows it is offline
Wait for the terrain selector offline
Screenshot: the flight offline
Read the terrain selector offline: still QA_<run>, no error

assert.expr: v['offline']['label'] is not None and ('QA_' + run) in v['offline']['label'] and v['offline']['error'] is False

steps.text: Bring the app to the front (closes a leftover file picker)
Leave the planner (always)
steps.helper: act.py {target} tap testid:btn-sites --expect "js:/Exit without saving/.test(document.body.innerText) || location.pathname === '/sites'" --timeout 20

steps.text: Exit without saving when asked (always; writes nothing)
Clean-up: Wi-Fi back on (always)
